statement.notes: Only the 'Depreciation of property and equipment' line item was directly mapped to the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. The statement does not show a separate 'Amortization' line. The 'Other' line in adjustments could potentially contain some amortization, but its composition is unspecified, so it was not included to avoid incorrect mapping. The supplementary tables provide lease-related details but do not contain separate depreciation/amortization figures for the cash flow statement.
